events.description: Roman conquest of Cisalpine Gaul; Celtic settlement of Medhelanon comes under Roman rule.
Visigoths besieged Milan; Emperor Honorius moved the imperial residence to Ravenna.
Attila the Hun besieged and sacked Milan.
Ostrogothic siege during Gothic War; after capitulation, according to Procopius, 300,000 male citizens were executed and women sold to Gothic allies.
Lombards conquered Milan, overpowering the Byzantine garrison.
Milan surrendered to Charlemagne and the Franks.
Frederick I Barbarossa brought the destruction of much of Milan.
Napoleon invaded Italy and declared Milan capital of the Cisalpine Republic.
The Five Days of Milan (18–22 March 1848): uprising against Austrian rule forced Field Marshal Radetzky to temporarily withdraw.
Following the Battle of Solferino, Milan and Lombardy were incorporated into Piedmont-Sardinia.
